name: MGHttpdProvider
description: Shared HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1:3420 that other client mods register path prefixes on (/ctl for mcctl, /aif for AdvancedInfoFetcher). GET / lists the endpoints that are mounted right now. When the client exits the provider stops its own server, so the non-daemon HTTP dispatcher cannot keep the JVM alive; it does not end the JVM and does not hide other mods' non-daemon threads.
